tool_input.command:
bq query --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** --use_legacy_sql=false \
'CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.churntrainingcdae59` AS
WITH l AS (
  SELECT account_id, label_time, churned,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY account_id, label_time) AS rid
  FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.stg_labels`
),
tx AS (
  SELECT rid, amount, balance FROM (
    SELECT l.rid, t.amount, t.balance,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.rid ORDER BY t.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM l JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.stg_transactions` t
      ON t.account_id=l.account_id AND t.event_time<=l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn=1
),
pr AS (
  SELECT rid, credit_score, tier FROM (
    SELECT l.rid, p.credit_score, p.tier,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.rid ORDER BY p.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM l JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.stg_profiles` p
      ON p.account_id=l.account_id AND p.event_time<=l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn=1
),
ac AS (
  SELECT rid, sessions_7d FROM (
    SELECT l.rid, a.sessions_7d,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.rid ORDER BY a.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM l JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.stg_activity` a
      ON a.account_id=l.account_id AND a.event_time<=l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn=1
),
ah AS (
  SELECT rid, health_score FROM (
    SELECT l.rid, h.health_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.rid ORDER BY h.event_time DESC) rn
    FROM l JOIN `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.stg_account_health` h
      ON h.account_id=l.account_id AND h.event_time<=l.label_time
  ) WHERE rn=1
)
SELECT l.account_id, l.label_time, tx.amount, tx.balance,
       pr.credit_score, pr.tier, ac.sessions_7d, ah.health_score, l.churned
FROM l
LEFT JOIN tx USING(rid)
LEFT JOIN pr USING(rid)
LEFT JOIN ac USING(rid)
LEFT JOIN ah USING(rid)
ORDER BY l.rid' 2>&1 | tail -5

bq show --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --format=prettyjson "$GCP_PROJECT:$GCP_BQ_DATASET.churntrainingcdae59" 2>&1 | grep -A2 '"name"' | grep '"name"'
echo "=== count + null check ==="
bq query --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** --use_legacy_sql=false --format=csv \
'SELECT COUNT(*) n,

 FROM `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab6c552c.churntrainingcdae59`' 2>&1 | tail -3
